owner: Parts Seller OS Rule Trainers + CEO-A Parts OS General Manager
purpose: Convert shared worker learning into concrete Parts Seller OS workflow rules and test cases.

what_workers_must_know: A part cannot be useful without part name, category, vehicle fitment, code confidence and condition state.
Vague titles reduce conversion and must trigger QA warning or block.
Side/position is mandatory for lamps, mirrors, doors, safety parts and many body parts.
rules_to_apply: If title is vague, listing_status = blocked.
If side-sensitive category lacks side_position, listing_status = needs_data.
If OEM/code exists, store normalized_oem_codes and aliases.
workflow_modules.test_case: Hyundai Santa Fe 'kita kėbulo dalis' must be blocked until exact part function is named.

what_workers_must_know: EU sellers converge around repeatable categories but labels vary by language/template.
We use our canonical category tree, not copied external taxonomy.
rules_to_apply: Map external pattern groups to canonical category_id.
Add required_attributes by category before listing readiness.
workflow_modules.test_case: Rear bumper lamp maps to lighting and requires left/right/front/rear context.

what_workers_must_know: Buyer searches by uncertainty: code, model, category or visible part name.
Vehicle generation, year range, engine, gearbox, body and LHD/RHD can change compatibility.
rules_to_apply: If fitment is incomplete, compatibility_confidence = low or manual_review.
Code-sensitive electronics require OEM/code match before sell_ready.
workflow_modules.test_case: Aston DBX window regulator code MY83-F23200-AC must not be priced/listed as generic regulator without fitment confidence.

what_workers_must_know: Seller OS must reduce warehouse labor, not only create listings.
Location suggestion depends on storage profile, dimensions, fragility, weight, frequency and occupancy.
rules_to_apply: Fragile lighting gets protected shelf/bin profile.
Oversize body parts require oversize zone and shipping warning.
If location occupancy > threshold, suggest fallback/pending queue.
workflow_modules.test_case: Rear lamp cannot go to heavy/dirty mechanical bin.

what_workers_must_know: Price signal is not final price unless source, date and confidence exist.
Low-value parts may be skip/bundle/auto-list if handling cost destroys margin.
rules_to_apply: If no source_url + checked_at + confidence, price_confidence = missing.
If high-value part and no comps, manual_review.
If price < handling threshold, mark bundle_or_skip unless automation makes it profitable.
workflow_modules.test_case: 15-25 EUR low-value public seed parts must trigger handling-cost review.

what_workers_must_know: Listing readiness is a business gate, not a cosmetic label.
rules_to_apply: ready requires clear title, category, price, photo_state, return_policy_state and shipping_profile.
manual_review for unknown warranty on high-value or risk-sensitive parts.
blocked for vague title, missing side where required or missing category mapping.
workflow_modules.test_case: Hyundai Terracan turbo needs condition/test notes before publish.

what_workers_must_know: A sold part creates operational work: reserve, pick, pack, ship, support and possible return.
Delivery layer must know scope and handoff before paid pilot or external promise.
rules_to_apply: Paid/reserved status blocks duplicate sale.
Oversize/fragile shipping requires delivery warning.
Return/warranty state follows order record.
workflow_modules.test_case: Reserved part cannot remain listed as available without warning.

what_workers_must_know: Stock that does not move costs space and money.
Ageing decisions must consider price, demand, storage cost, category and rare-part value.
rules_to_apply: Old low-value bulky item -> discount/bundle/scrap review.
Rare expensive item -> promote/price review, not automatic discount.
Repeated views without sale -> title/photo/price review.
workflow_modules.test_case: Rare DBX part should not be auto-discounted like common low-value part.

training_done_proof: Each workflow module has rules_to_apply and test_case.
At least 3 sample parts pass full workflow.
CFO layer validates low-value handling and premium rare-part logic.
next_actions: Wire these module rules into products/parts-seller-os UI and sample data.
Create 3 sample parts test run from RRR seed and internal rare-part examples.
